description: This Java source file defines a class LoanInterestRecalculationCOBBusinessStep, which is responsible for performing interest recalculation logic on loan objects within the context of a batch process or COB (Close of Business) operation in the Fineract project. It implements the LoanCOBBusinessStep interface and uses services like LoanWritePlatformService to execute interest recalculations with appropriate checks for loan status and overdue installments.

classes.name: LoanInterestRecalculationCOBBusinessStep
classes.description: A class that executes interest recalculation logic for loans during COB processing, implementing the LoanCOBBusinessStep interface.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs interest recalculation on a loan if it passes several status and configuration checks. Uses the loanWritePlatformService to recalculate interest and manages thread context for COB processing.

methods.name: hasOverdueInstallment
methods.description: Checks if the loan has any overdue installments by evaluating the due date and obligation status of each installment.

methods.name: getEnumStyledName
methods.description: Returns a string representing the enum style name for this process step.

methods.name: getHumanReadableName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable name for this COB business step.
